articles.question: Why is a shipment charge missing or in a billing exception?
articles.answer: Billing exceptions occur when automated rules detect missing rates, unbilled manual work, zero-rated events, or potential revenue leakage. You can review open exceptions and resolve or waive them individually or in bulk with required justification notes.
steps: Go to Billing and select Exceptions to open the Exceptions & Revenue Leakage Center.
Review open exceptions, severity indicators, descriptions, and linked shipment or client records.
To clear a single exception, type a justification reason into its row and select Resolve or Waive.
To update multiple exceptions at once, select the checkboxes next to the target rows.
Enter a required reason in the bulk toolbar and click Resolve Selected or Waive Selected.
